units.source_text: 然后，我也产生了一股孩子赶庙会看热闹般的喜悦的心情。

en.t: Then I too felt a kind of joy, like a child going to a temple fair to watch the excitement.

units.source_text: 宾兵从四面八方把金刚院团团包围起来，并要求村民们协助。

en.t: The military police surrounded Kongoin from every direction and asked the villagers to help.

units.source_text: 我出于幸灾乐祸，随同其他五六个少年一起，加入了以有为子为向导的第一队。

en.t: Out of malicious delight, I joined five or six other boys in the first group, with Uiko as our guide.

units.source_text: 有为子在宪兵的解押下，率先踏上了洒满月光的路。

en.t: Escorted by the military police, Uiko was the first to step onto the road flooded with moonlight.

units.source_text: 我对于她那充满信心的步伐，感到异常震惊。

en.t: I was strangely shaken by the confidence in her stride.
